verdict.rationale: Every probe failed to retrieve an actual robots policy. www.nvsos.gov/robots.txt first returned an Akamai 403, then a 200 Imperva Incapsula bot-challenge interstitial. esos.nv.gov/robots.txt redirected to an Incapsula noindex shell, so an agent cannot learn what it may read before fetching.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
